locations.note: In Yongen-Jaya, the game's Sangenjaya, Joker lives in the attic of Sojiro Sakura's Café Leblanc; the Sakura house next door holds Futaba's Palace.
Joker's new school, where the gym teacher Kamoshida's abuse of his students becomes the first Palace, a castle, and the Phantom Thieves are born.
The Thieves' hub: they meet in the station square, enter Mementos from Shibuya, and find mob boss Kaneshiro's Palace, a bank, covering the whole district.
Joker goes to Shinjuku's nightlife district at night, where the journalist Ohya and the fortune teller Chihaya become his confidants.
Joker can walk Akihabara's electronics and game shops on his free afternoons.
In a church in Kanda, Joker finds the shogi player Hifumi Togo practising alone and becomes her student as one of his confidants.
Joker can go fishing at the Ichigaya fishing pond once he has read the book Fishpond Spotter or gone along on Ryuji's invitation.
A book or a friend's invitation opens Meiji Shrine to Joker, who can visit it by day but not in the evening.
Prosecutor Sae Niijima's courthouse in Kasumigaseki becomes her Palace, a rigged casino, and the place where Joker is caught.
Masayoshi Shido sees the Diet as a cruise ship sailing over a drowned Tokyo; in this Palace the Thieves fight Akechi and change Shido's heart.
In Royal, Joker and Kasumi find a Palace in Odaiba that turns out to be the counsellor Maruki's, the last one the Thieves must enter.
Royal adds Kichijōji and its shopping streets; Joker spends free days there with friends and can find the shogi player Hifumi at its shogi hall.
Before Royal opened up the rest of Kichijōji, Inokashira Park was already a spot where Joker could spend a free day with a friend.
Shujin's second-years, with Makoto, go to Hawaii on their class trip and spend days on the beach and in the shops.

routes.name: The Phantom Thieves' Palaces
routes.note: From the attic in Yongen-Jaya through Kamoshida's castle, Kaneshiro's bank, Futaba's Palace, Sae's casino and Shido's ship to the depths of Mementos, and in Royal on to Maruki's Palace in Odaiba.
